rep_mode_check.name: rep_mode_check
rep_mode_check.value: rep_mode IS NULL OR rep_mode IN ('total', 'per_side')

plan_days_expected_duration_check.name: plan_days_expected_duration_check
plan_days_expected_duration_check.value: expected_duration_min IS NULL OR (expected_duration_min BETWEEN 1 AND 600)

plan_days_expected_rpe_check.name: plan_days_expected_rpe_check
plan_days_expected_rpe_check.value: expected_rpe IS NULL OR (expected_rpe BETWEEN 1 AND 10)

plan_days_time_of_day_check.name: plan_days_time_of_day_check
plan_days_time_of_day_check.value: planned_time_of_day_min IS NULL OR (planned_time_of_day_min BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)

workout_structure_rest_step_target_restr.name: workout_structure_rest_step_target_restrictions_check
workout_structure_rest_step_target_restr.value:
step_type <> 'rest' OR (
      exercise_name IS NULL
      AND custom_label IS NULL
      AND target_reps IS NULL
      AND target_time IS NULL
      AND target_distance IS NULL
      AND target_weight IS NULL
    )
